description: Catalogue of NodajiFi hands-on skill labs (practicums such as pipetting or a billiards stance): title, domain and sub-domain. Metadata only — lab steps, scoring and results are inside the app.

domain.description: Domain filter, e.g. science or billiards.

language.description: Title language: ar, en, es, fr, id, ko, pt, vi. Default en; a lab without a title in that language is shown in English (see language on each lab), and skipped if it has neither.

name: nodajifi_list_skills
title: List NodajiFi hands-on skill labs
